targetText: Let them try to prepare for (and then implement) the dictatorship of the proletariat, without a rigorously centralised party with iron discipline, without the ability to become masters of every sphere, every branch, and every variety of political and cultural work.
explanation: Bolshevik party discipline was not maintained through blind obedience, but through vanguard class-consciousness, deep ties to working people, and practical tactical success.
